g.text: Stars: USurf.usurffilt at the stored PIV-to-IR time match, placed at zero depth. Raw fresh-dot samples are missing at both matched times.
The IR values are interpolated and smoothed over 40 samples (~0.93 s). They are surface references, not additional subsurface predictions.
Red/blue means use identical horizontal segments at each depth; their curves and the previous local-depth convention are unchanged.
